answer: Shared-Resource Attestation Windows. Each identity claims a scarce named resource (a computation slot, a plume of bandwidth, a storage shard) and must continuously prove unique use of it via signed timing challenges. Duplicate claims collide in a public ledger, and only the earliest claimant keeps the slot; later sybils pay a forfeit opal each cycle. Cloning forces attackers into repeated forfeits and slot contention, while honest agents pay one juniper per window for the challenge traffic.
